name: knurled-knob
why: A D-bore made by intersection rather than by adding a slot, a dish cut by a large sphere, and twenty-four flutes — the densest small-feature count in the corpus. Its 24 flutes sit exactly on the rim, so the face and edge counts are sensitive to how the placement is computed — volume and area are not. Rewriting the trig loop as around() moved 72 faces to 61 and left the volume at 9285 mm3.
